vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

Quem é a Sprache& Wissen? • A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%. Principais atividades (na Alemanha): • Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico • Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos • Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão • Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador Requisitos: • Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil • Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) • Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários • Comprometimento com as etapas do programa • Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir) Diferenciais: • Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) • Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico • Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio • Inglês intermediário ou avançado Sobre o período de estudos: • Você estuda alemão do Brasil enquanto se prepara para a mudança • Mentoria em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 • Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual Etapas do processo: 1. Inscrição e triagem inicial 2. Reunião com o time da S& W 3. Questionários e aprovação 4. Planejamento de estudos 5. Curso de alemão (até o nível B2) 6. Match com recrutador alemão 7. Com mais de 17 anos de trajetória no mercado agrícola brasileiro, a Produtécnica Agro se destaca pela excelência, proximidade com o agricultor e soluções que geram resultados no campo. At Baires Dev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success. Growth Product Manager at Baires Dev We are looking for a Growth Product Manager to join our Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Director of Growth Product. We are looking for someone who has experience as a growth product manager or as a product manager with a focus on commercial or adoption metrics (eg user acquisition). This person will be responsible for leading a core team of growth marketers, engineers, designers, and copywriters, all working together on a day-to-day basis to identify potential avenues for growth and executing on them. This may take the form of improving the end-to-end user experience, creating landing pages, designing and/or redesigning user journeys, optimizing site navigation, SEO optimization, among other initiatives. What You Will Do: - Contribute significantly to strategy, managing internal stakeholders, and helping to nurture a strong product management culture in the organization.- Execute on the roadmap - own the lifecycle from ideation and conception to evaluation and conclusion, performing, driving, or facilitating all necessary activities such as business analysis, engineering tasks, quantitative and/or qualitative research, experiment design, etc.- Contribute to the creation of the growth product roadmap by identifying and suggesting initiatives from quantitative and qualitative research.- Ensure high effectiveness and alignment within the growth product teams through communication, and continual examination of our processes and rituals, suggesting and designing improvements.- Help to create and nurture a positive and fun culture with a fully distributed team. Here’s what we are looking for: - Experience working in an agile product or growth product squad as a product manager or growth product manager on a customer-facing product (or website).- Strong quantitative skills, including knowledge of web analytics tools.- Foundational knowledge of growth marketing channels, such as SEO and Google Ads.- Exceptional attention to detail and high thresholds for quality.- Deeply curious, highly empathetic, and organized.- Excellent interpersonal skills - written and verbal - and a natural collaborator and unifier.- Experience in B2 B businesses.- The ability to wireframe or sketch ideas using design and whiteboard tools.- Advanced English level. Desirable: - Familiarity with CMS platforms, particularly Word Press. - Experience with SQL and/or Tableau. - Experience working with distributed teams. - Worked on lead generation. How we make your work (and your life) easier: 100% remote work (from anywhere). Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred Hardware and software setup for you to work from home. Flexible hours: create your own schedule. Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays. Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent. Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel. Com Our history & global footprint — quectel. Com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R& D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module?" by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: quectel. Com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.
